terminology.candidatePool: The full approved evidence set for a role. Pools are NOT sent to a generator.
terminology.runtimePack: The 4-6 (single) or 6-8 (duo) images actually selected for one task, drawn from the pools by role.
terminology.changedInV12: v1.1 called both of these a 'pack'. A literal reading loaded 11 identity anchors and busted the budget before adding pose or product.

runtimeSelection.upperGuideline: 8-10 only when every image has a demonstrably distinct role
runtimeSelection.rule: Select BY ROLE from candidatePools. Never emit a whole pool.

CORE_FACE.note: Preserved unchanged from v1.1. Audit confirmed complete angle coverage.

EXPRESSIONS.note: Add only when the requested expression differs materially from neutral.

FASHION_POSE.defaultRankRule: Two per wardrobe series, spread within the series, clothed editorial series first.
FASHION_POSE.note: All v1.1 candidates retained. Ranking only changes what the selector reaches for first.

EYEWEAR.note: Full-body frames. Eyewear occupies roughly 2% of frame height; no temple, lens or frame detail is readable.

IDENTITY_DETAILS.rule: Do NOT borrow INA detail frames and do NOT infer piercings, jewellery or ear anatomy for SIS.
IDENTITY_DETAILS.effect: Any task requiring a SIS identity detail sets identityConfidence to LOW and raises a warning.
IDENTITY_DETAILS.resolution: Capture SIS ear/detail macros in the next calibration session.

BLAZER_EDITORIAL.note: DEFAULT for commercial hero and retail work. Only clothed, camera-facing DUO family.

FOUNDATION_STORY.reason: Underwear-series frames; DUO/IMG_3497.JPEG has both subjects facing away. Not suitable as the automatic composition reference for clothed retail or hero work.
FOUNDATION_STORY.permittedUse: Explicit owner request, or duo body-geometry study only.

knownLibraryLimits.orientation: All 190 frames are portrait 1536x2048. No landscape or 9:16 reference exists.
knownLibraryLimits.environment: All 190 frames share one location and flat daylight. No environmental variety.
knownLibraryLimits.negativeSpace: Subjects are centred and fill the frame. No frame demonstrates offset-subject copy space.
knownLibraryLimits.productGeometry: No frame contains a PINK MALL catalogue SKU. Product frames show personal items.
knownLibraryLimits.effect: These limits lower compositionConfidence and productConfidence; they do not lower identityConfidence.

wardrobeAuthorityNote: Every frame in every pool below is an identityReference. None is a wardrobeAuthority. The calibration clothing keeps body geometry readable; it carries no PINK MALL assortment information and must never be copied as styling. See WARDROBE_AUTHORITY.json.
identityAuthorityNote: INA pools are authoritative only for INA, SIS pools only for SIS, DUO pools for staging only and never for identity. See IDENTITY_COLLISION_PROTOCOL.json.
